limitations: Authored synthetic CRM requirements, six selected browser tests and two controlled faults; not production or customer evidence.
Acceptance remains partial: one activated dashboard-value fault survived both runs because its value assertion is missing.
Source ZIP verification used Node 22.23.4 on macOS arm64. Other platforms were not verified in this run.
The no-Git source ZIP has no observed source revision or Git cleanliness. Revision remains null and dirty is conservatively true.
Graph coverage, gaps and duplicate findings are static candidates from one repository snapshot, not runtime acceptance.
Hosted planning and local model assessment were skipped. Provider agreement, performance, token use and cost were not measured.
Observed time is the original demo run creation time. Release implementation checks are separate and are not included.
Receipt identities cross-check recorded local evidence. They are provenance metadata, not authenticated proof or independent human review.
